_readme: Figures that must agree everywhere they are stated on the site.
This file is the single source. tools/check_figures.py reads it, and the
admin panel reads it in the browser to run the same check before a publish.
Duplicating the list in JavaScript would put two copies in the repo that can
drift apart, which hard rule 9 in CLAUDE.md forbids.
name      what the figure is, used in the failure message
accepted  every value string that is correct
patterns  regexes that capture the value where the figure is stated
note      optional, why the entry exists or what it must not be confused with
Every capturing group in every pattern is compared against accepted. Write one
pattern per phrasing already in use, and prefer a slightly loose pattern over a
clever one. If a phrasing is not matched the check stays silent, which is the
safe direction; a wrong pattern that matches the wrong number is not.
PATTERNS MUST BE PORTABLE between Python re and JavaScript RegExp, because both
run them. Stay inside the common subset: \s \d, character classes, non-capturing
groups, alternation, ? * +. Do not use named groups, lookbehind, \A \Z, inline
flags, or possessive quantifiers. tools/check_figures.py compiles every pattern
on startup and fails if one is invalid.

figures.name: cultivated area, 2025
figures.note: matches '... to about 3,665 as of 2025' and '... to 3,665 hectares as of 2025'

figures.name: Iran's share of world saffron production
PDO Azafran de La Mancha colouring power floor
figures.note: The PDO's own floor, NOT the ISO 3632 Category I floor. The site states the ISO figure as 190 or 200 and read-lab-report explains why sources differ. Conflating the two is the defect this entry exists to catch, so the patterns deliberately key on 'colouring power', which is the PDO's wording and appears nowhere else on the site.

figures.name: water test, thread count
figures.note: Restated by the purity checker as well as by purity-tests, which is exactly the drift this file exists to catch: the tool and the post must not disagree about how the test is run.
patterns: Place\s+([\d-]+)\s+threads in a glass of cold water

figures.name: ISO 3632 moisture maximum, percent
figures.note: Stated in five posts and in the purity checker's cannotSee panel.
